480:t_009:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「Let's do this, everyone! Our target is $$エルーナルーナ$$!」

480:t_009:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We'll all protect everyone on $$チームＤ$$ together!」

480:t_009:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「So, $$葵$$! Please wake up already!」

480:t_009:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「So, $$葵$$! Please wake up already!」

480:t_009:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「HA! Party time's about to begin!」

480:t_010:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice, $c! It's not just that girl and my Darling - everybody gets to have fun!」

480:t_010:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「This is thanks to that girl's beast blood, too!」

480:t_010:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit getting all hyped up on your own!」

480:t_011:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You really hang in there, $c! Is this thanks to that girl's beast blood, too?!」

480:t_011:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Quit getting all hyped up on your own!」

480:t_012:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Damn! That woman's ship keeps powering up more and more!」

480:t_012:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「It's the power of the $$スフィア$$ that reacts to desire!」

480:t_012:2.en:
$$凱$$
「So basically, the more fun she has fighting, the more her power goes up?!」

480:t_012:3.en:
$$渓$$
「Just how ridiculous can that woman get?!」

480:t_012:5.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I know. Like $$チームＤ$$, that woman has a wild nature.」

480:t_012:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we can shatter that fighting spirit, even for an instant, we can stop her.」

480:t_012:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「What the hell are you doing, $$葵$$! Hurry up and wake up, and blow that cow lady's mind!」

480:t_012:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「She encouraged me when Bro died, and when I was about to propose to $$ニア$$.」

480:t_012:13.en:
$$シモン$$
「So this time, I'm the one who's going to help $$葵$$!」

480:t_012:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Hold on, $$シモン$$! You guys aren't the only ones who owe them one!」

480:t_012:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Their wild spirit has always been what lit the fire under our fighting spirit.」

480:t_012:16.en:
$$タケル$$
「Even when they play it cool, $$チームＤ$$'s hearts have always burned hot.」

480:t_012:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Watching them makes me want to howl like a beast too - GAOOO!」

480:t_012:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「So! Let me hear it one more time, $$葵$$! That burning roar of yours!」

480:t_012:20.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「It's useless! Those kids' fangs have already been broken!」

480:t_012:21.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「True, they were defeated... For a wild animal, that means death...」

480:t_012:22.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「But they are not beasts! They are humans with a wild nature hidden within!」

480:t_012:23.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That is why they stand up again, no matter how many times! Of their own will! To fight the enemy they must defeat!」

480:t_013:2.en:
$$青山$$
「But just before that, something like a dimensional quake occurred...!」

480:t_013:3.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That is no spare. It is the true $$断空剣$$.」

480:t_013:6.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Among all the universes, only one $$断空剣$$ exists... And now it is being passed down together with their souls.」

480:t_013:9.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And feel it! The feelings poured into the $$断空剣$$!」

480:t_014:2.en:
$$葵$$
「I can feel it... The feelings poured into this blade...」

480:t_014:4.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Heh heh... Not a bad feeling.」

480:t_014:5.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So the heart of love has torn apart the evil space.」

480:t_014:6.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「And the fog that clouded our hearts, too.」

480:t_014:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Nice one! But I would've preferred you stay asleep, you know!」

480:t_015:0.en:
$$メール$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$'s coming!」

480:t_016:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You're going to try the same thing again?! What a beast that never learns!」

480:t_016:1.en:
$$葵$$
「Sorry, $$エルーナルーナ$$! We're not beasts!」

480:t_016:3.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's why we were able to stand up like this!」

480:t_016:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「And we can feel our bonds with the people we care about...」

480:t_016:5.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「and turn them into strength!」

480:t_016:6.en:
$$葵$$
「Take this! This $$断空剣$$ holds the souls of the people who support $$チームＤ$$!」

480:t_017:1.en:
$$葵$$
「We're not done yet, $$エルーナルーナ$$! We won't stop!」

480:t_018:0.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Fly, $$チームＤ$$! Carry the feelings of so many people toward the future humanity is meant to reach!」

480:t_019:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「And what controls it is their will... truly their feelings.」

480:t_019:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Indeed. They have surpassed the beast... and now they are about to surpass the human.」

480:t_019:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「That hit home...! My head's spinning for the first time in ages!」

480:t_020:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Sorry, $$ダバラーン$$. The mission's a failure.」
